reviews.title: Exactly as pictured.
reviews.text: Bright rooms, a well-equipped kitchen and a terrace we never wanted to leave. The host answered every message within the hour.

reviews.title: Ideal, um den See zu erkunden.
reviews.text: Ruhige Straße, einfaches Parken und nur ein kurzer Spaziergang zur Fähre. Die Betten könnten etwas fester sein.

en.title: A great base for exploring the lake.
en.text: Quiet street, easy parking and only a short walk to the ferry. The beds could be a little firmer.

reviews.title: A wonderful family holiday.
reviews.text: Plenty of room for two families, and the children spent every afternoon in the garden.
Spotless, comfortable and in a lovely spot. We would stay again.
Lovely home with a great view. The road up is steep, so a small car helps.
Beautiful house and a very kind host.
